frozen_decisions_applied: Plan #10, verbatim: 'Production uses the S5 encrypted current certificate/key slot. Its certificate must chain to the configured product management CA and contain both the exact mDNS DNS SAN and URI SAN urn:zgw:<gateway_id>.' -- implemented via two mbedtls_x509_crt_verify() calls (one per SAN value), each independently checking chain-to-CA, expiry, and the respective SAN, plus mbedtls_pk_check_pair() for the private-key/certificate pairing.

Plan #11, verbatim: 'Missing CA, invalid issuer/SAN/expiry/key match or unreadable current slot keeps the production management listener disabled.' -- web_server.cpp's start_production_https() now reads the CA (previously never read) and refuses to start on any non-VALID hal_tls_validate_certificate() result, in addition to its existing unreadable-slot gate from Section 2.7.

Real mbedtls API used exactly as confirmed via direct recon against the real espressif/idf:release-v5.5 source (not assumed from memory or header comments alone): mbedtls_x509_crt_verify()'s cn parameter checks chain+expiry+one-SAN-value in a single call (confirmed by reading the library's own x509_crt_verify_name()/x509_crt_check_san() implementation); mbedtls_esp_random() is a real, public, documented f_rng-compatible wrapper around esp_fill_random().

The validation module was relocated from components/service to components/app_hal (as hal_tls_certificate_validator.h/.c, a plain-C hal_* module) after check_arch_invariants.sh's INV-H002 correctly flagged mbedtls_x509_crt_free()/mbedtls_pk_free() calls under components/service -- matching hal_ota.c's own pre-existing precedent for exactly this category of mbedtls parse/free code.

hal_tls_certificate_validator_implemente.detail: hal_tls_validate_certificate() parses cert/CA/key via mbedtls_x509_crt_parse()/mbedtls_pk_parse_key(), verifies chain+expiry+DNS-SAN via one mbedtls_x509_crt_verify() call, chain+expiry+URI-SAN via a second call, and private-key/certificate pairing via mbedtls_pk_check_pair() -- returning one of 7 typed results (kValid or 6 specific failure reasons). ESP_PLATFORM-only real implementation; host builds get a fail-closed stub (always HAL_TLS_CERT_VALIDATION_CERTIFICATE_PARSE_FAILED regardless of input) matching hal_ota.c's own #ifdef ESP_PLATFORM-guarded-body convention exactly.

build_gateway_uri_san_implemented.detail: New pure-logic function in provisioning_secrets.hpp/.cpp: builds exactly 'urn:zgw:<12-lowercase-hex-chars>' (plan #10's own literal URI SAN format). Host-testable (no crypto dependency), even though its one real consumer (web_server.cpp) is ESP_PLATFORM-only.

web_server_wired.detail: start_production_https() now reads the product CA via tls_identity_get_product_ca() (S5, previously never called anywhere in this repository), builds the expected DNS SAN (build_gateway_mdns_host() + '.local') and URI SAN (build_gateway_uri_san()), and calls hal_tls_validate_certificate() before ever calling httpd_ssl_start(). Any non-VALID result keeps the listener from starting.

architecture_gate_finding_resolved.status: COMPLETE -- real INV-H002 finding, corrected by relocation not suppression
architecture_gate_finding_resolved.detail: The first version of this validation logic lived under components/service/tls_certificate_validator.hpp/.cpp. check_arch_invariants.sh flagged INV-H002 ('service layer must not use malloc/calloc/realloc/free') against mbedtls_x509_crt_free()/mbedtls_pk_free() calls -- a genuinely correct finding, not a false positive: those functions manage mbedtls's own internal heap allocations, exactly the category of code hal_ota.c's own pre-existing mbedtls_pk_free()/mbedtls_ecdsa_free() calls already establish belongs in components/app_hal, which INV-H002's check does not scope to at all. Relocated to components/app_hal/hal_tls_certificate_validator.h/.c (plain C, matching every other file in that directory) rather than suppressed via docs/architecture/ADR_EXCEPTIONS.md (a mechanism reserved for temporary, dated exceptions, not a permanent architectural fit). Re-ran cppcheck and check_arch_invariants.sh after relocation: both clean.

real_bug_found_and_fixed.status: COMPLETE -- found only by the real ZGW_PRODUCTION_BUILD=1 target build
real_bug_found_and_fixed.detail: web_server.cpp's new runtime_->gateway_id() call (needed to build the expected SAN values) failed to compile with 'invalid use of incomplete type class service::ServiceRuntimeApi' -- web_server.hpp (via web_routes.hpp) only forward-declares that class; no prior translation unit needed the full definition. The ordinary (non-production) build never exercises this code path at all (compiled out entirely by the existing #if CONFIG_ZGW_PRODUCTION_PROFILE guard from Section 2.7), so only a real production-profile target build could catch this. Fixed by adding #include "service_runtime_api.hpp"; confirmed via a second, clean ZGW_PRODUCTION_BUILD=1 build (1201/1201 steps).

deviations_from_literal_plan_text.deviation: The validation module lives in components/app_hal (a plain-C hal_* module) rather than components/service, where every other S6/S6-adjacent sub-slice's logic has lived so far.
deviations_from_literal_plan_text.why: check_arch_invariants.sh's INV-H002 correctly identified that mbedtls_x509_crt_free()/mbedtls_pk_free() calls -- required to free mbedtls's own internally heap-allocated parse buffers -- violate the service layer's 'no malloc/calloc/realloc/free' invariant. This exact category of mbedtls parse/free code already lives in components/app_hal via hal_ota.c's own pre-existing mbedtls_pk_free()/mbedtls_ecdsa_free() calls -- app_hal is where this project's architecture already puts it.
deviations_from_literal_plan_text.consequence: None negative -- this is a correction to the intended, correct architecture, not a compromise. The public API (hal_tls_validate_certificate(), a plain C function) is trivially callable from the C++ web_ui component via extern "C" linkage, same as every other hal_* function this project already calls from C++ code.

deviations_from_literal_plan_text.deviation: A production build's HTTPS listener still always refuses to start today, even after this sub-slice -- the fail-closed gate is now real and complete (checks trustworthiness, not just presence), but no real certificate/key/CA material exists anywhere in this repository's storage for it to actually validate as VALID.
deviations_from_literal_plan_text.why: No real certificate-issuance workflow exists yet (plan #10-#12's own remaining piece, and ultimately blocked on the same manufacturing/eFuse environment gap as plan #6-#8, S5) -- this sub-slice's job was making the validation gate real and correct, not fabricating certificate material to make it pass.
deviations_from_literal_plan_text.consequence: This sub-slice cannot be end-to-end tested against a real certificate on real hardware (no manufacturing environment exists) -- verification stops at 'the real mbedtls calls compile and link correctly and the production call site threads the right data through them', matching this project's own established, honest bar for ESP_PLATFORM-only crypto logic that cannot be host-tested (hal_ota.c's own manifest-signature verification is held to the identical bar).
